schema_name: TableGate LifeSimulator Race Token Folder and File Tree

dynamic_bloodline.folder_name_source: The first true soul-bonded animal or creature name
dynamic_bloodline.rule: The first true soul-bonded animal or creature permanently establishes an open-ended soul-animal bloodline.

open_bloodline_note.behavior: No fixed bloodline folders or fabricated token files are listed because each bloodline is established by the first true soul-bonded animal or creature. Fourteen explicit identity filename requirements are provided inside the Deorbasun node for every actual soul-animal bloodline created.
